errors.evidence: The description does not state what is represented by the chart, such as the perplexity of LLaMA1-7B on different datasets with varying quantization bits.
The description does not mention the labels of the axes or the scale type for the x-axis (Quantization Bits) and the y-axis (Perplexity).
The description misses the details about the colors of the bars and their representation in the legend.
The arrangement of bars into groups for each dataset (WikiText, PTB, C4) is not described, nor is the fact that the chart includes three separate bar charts.
There is no information provided on the heights or approximate values of the bars.
